race.comment: Surprised BUCCLEUCH (1) didn't go up shorter in early markets and tipping he can round out Cup day a winner. His form this time in has been largely impeccable, the only miss coming as $2.30 favourite in Listed company. He bounced back with a strong win at Caulfield last time in similar company and gets every chance from the good draw again for Billy Egan who gets along very well with the horse. NO FUSS (13) is off a long break but looked talented 18 months ago. Interesting placement on Cup day off the break, watch betting. JETT SMASH (7) started favourite to beat BUCCLEUCH last time and had every hope to do so when fading into sixth. The end of 1400m, especially at Flemington, poses a query but he'll give a sight. Wary of EVERAIN (12) who had no luck first up and now draws out getting to 1400m.
